question.text: A PMS client wants MONTHLY rebalancing but the PM prefers QUARTERLY. Resolution:

answer.text: Document preference in IPS and communicate cost trade-off; agreement required

explanation.text: The Logic: Client preference + PM judgment = dialogue. Document in IPS; quantify cost impact. The Trap: Unilateral overrides break the client relationship. Cross-Exam Context: Practical. Manager's Pro-Tip: Client education on rebalancing costs often leads them to accept quarterly — transparent cost analysis helps.
